name: Korea Zinc Company, Ltd.
summary: Korea Zinc Company, Ltd. operates as a general non-ferrous metal smelting company primarily in South Korea. The company offers zinc slab ingots, alloy jumbo blocks, anode ingots, and die cast ingots; and lead and lead alloy ingots; and copper cathodes. The company also provides gold and silver; and rare metals, including indium, bismuth, antimony, cadmium, tellurium, and cobalt; and sulfuric acid, semiconductor sulfuric acid, and oleum.
